feeding_claim.verbatim: Our beef never receive Vaccines, antibiotics, hormones, or grain of any kind.

notes: Checked 2026-11-15: the about us page (homepage and store could not be fetched this run). The farm has raised beef since 2018 with calves born on the farm; the about page says the cattle get no grain of any kind, graze grass and get hay in winter, and the site headline says 100% grass fed and finished, so the category is grass-finished. Whole beef is $5 per lb and half beef $5.50 per lb hanging weight with a $100 deposit, processed at Cedar Creek Meats (Laotto), Pork N' Cleaver (Albion) or Integrity Meats (Churubusco), or a buyer's processor within an hour of Wolf Lake. Online orders are picked up at a chosen location and paid before pickup. The farm began selling at an unnamed farmers market in spring 2024. Tallow products listed earlier could not be confirmed and were removed.
